headline_findings: whisper.cpp v1.9.4 + whisper-server file-POST and whisper-stream mic mode is the safest offline STT default; large-v3-turbo (809M, 4 decoder layers) is ~2.7-5x faster than large-v3 at +0.4pp WER.
Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (CC-BY-4.0, 25 langs) with NeMo-Speech.cpp q8 GGUF is the fastest accurate alternative to Whisper; batch-128 RTFx 3380 does not transfer to batch-1 laptop.

Kokoro-82M int8 ONNX (~92MB, Apache-2.0) is the default local TTS; Piper covers ultra-cheap CPU prompts; Qwen3-TTS-0.6B reports 97ms first packet; Chatterbox Turbo/Nano give MIT-licensed cloning with watermark.

Voice mode: ship push-to-talk first, then Silero+WebRTC dual-pass VAD auto-turn, barge-in behind a flag with AEC and <20ms TTS flush; no RTX 3070 Ti batch-1 voice latencies are published, soak-test locally.
